name: [🎃] Kukirin Life [Testing]
desc:
⚠️The game is still in testing, expect bugs! ⚠️

Welcome to Kukirin Life, the best e-scooter game on ROBLOX.

🏙️ Big map with many varied roads
🔥 The best driving system
🔨 Very rich customization
👮 Fun and responsive police chases
💥 Achievements, quests and way more

The game is constantly getting updated with tons of scooters, POIs and other content to come.

⚠️This is a fan-made KuKirin game. We are not associated with KuKirin ⚠️

Made with ❤️ by fade & noel
